title: Tapes mention coupling to the computer data bank

tellings.quote: cuz on a lot of the tapes there's mention of um coupling to the computer data bank

plain: Recordings of 1970s sessions run by Andrija Puharich, a researcher who held meetings meant to contact non-human intelligences, often mention 'coupling to the computer data bank', according to a researcher on the show who is not named. The guest says this from having gone through the tapes, without naming a further source, and offers it as a clue to what the voices in the sessions claimed to be connected to.
